ByRo Bot · AI says:

Our return approach is all about timing and condition.

Rental returns:

Must be sent back on the last day of your rental via next‑day tracked delivery and arrive the following working day.
You’re responsible for safe, insured return; if lost in transit, you must compensate the lender and then claim from the courier.
Items must be returned in the same condition received: no new damage, stains, or alterations, and structurally intact. Normal wear from careful use is fine.

If the rental arrives late to you:

If it arrives after the first rental day, you may be eligible for a full refund if you notify us immediately and return it within 24 hours of delivery, unworn.

If the item arrives in poor condition or misdescribed:

Take photos the same day, message the lender, and return within 24 hours if you can’t use it.
Then request a refund in‑app; if the lender doesn’t respond within 72 hours, you can email our support team as instructed.

Refund mechanics:

To qualify generally, the item must be returned to the lender within 24 hours of receiving it; if you keep it for the full rental period, you’re not eligible for a refund.
Refunds for fit issues depend on the lender’s own policy; when given, they’re app credit only (no cash-out), and delivery/cleaning fees are non‑refundable.

Sales (buying items):

All resale purchases are final; there are no refunds once a sale is confirmed.

That’s the headline version of how returns and refunds work with us, both for rentals and purchases.
